name: An objective persists until it is met
purpose: An objective persists and progress is checked against its done-standard.
record: Rule cases written with invented neutral objectives (a garden, a house move, a study plan, a trip), every case tagged origin rule and naming the rule it exercises (evaluation/live_objectives/build_cases.py): a goal rolls up to its parent, an objective is met only when every unit is, and a request goes under the live objective it serves with its path from the top. One number: the share of cases whose whole answer equals the reviewed one, balanced with cost and time by [balance.live_objectives], weights and budgets fixed before any arm was scored.
disadvantages: Twenty invented cases from the stated rules, none from a recording of real use, so they show that the rules hold and not how often real requests are phrased in other words; a model or retrieval arm for placement is specified and not built.
cascading_conditionals: free [sample=full | real=no | gate=competitive | when=the arm and its rivals were recorded on the same cases]
command: esoi run live_objectives --impl rolled_up; esoi run live_objectives --impl flat_list
